ns2:section.sectionText: Priority registration is given to Junior and Senior Food Science majors. All ACES students can register starting Nov 18 at 10am. **All students should be aware that the PHYS 101 and MATH 220 prerequisites for this course will be strictly enforced. Any registered student who hasn't met the prereqs will be dropped from the course.**
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Agr & Consumer Economics, Agr, Consumer, & Env Sciences, Ag Ldrshp Educ Comm Program, Agr, Consumer, & Env Sci Admn, Food Science & Human Nutrition, Agricultural & Biological Engr, Human Dvlpmt & Family Studies, Crop Sciences, Natural Res & Env Sci, or Nutritional Sciences department.
